During the Financial Year 2025–2026, the Company approved the issuance of Equity Warrants on a preferential basis at a face value of ₹10 per warrant with a premium of ₹340 per warrant, aggregating to a total issue size of ₹273.72 crore. Pursuant to the aforesaid approval, the Company allotted 77,33,701 Fully Convertible Warrants and 86,856 Equity Shares on September 18, 2025. During the Financial Year 2025–2026, out of the aforesaid warrants, a total of 37,72,792 Fully Convertible Warrants were converted into Equity Shares in accordance with the terms of issue, and 39,60,909 Fully Convertible Warrants remained outstanding. During the six-month period ended September 30, 2026, 39,60,909 Fully Convertible Warrants were converted into Equity Shares in accordance with the terms of issue. This included the conversion of 14,55,235 warrants on May 02, 2026, 71,428 warrants on May 21, 2026, 71,428 warrants on June 04, 2026, 10,77,105 warrants on July 27, 2026, and 12,85,713 warrants on September 01, 2026. Consequently, the cumulative number of Fully Convertible Warrants converted into Equity Shares increased to 77,33,701, and all such warrants have been fully converted into Equity Shares. Accordingly, no Fully Convertible Warrants remained outstanding for conversion as at September 30, 2026.
